note: A15.8 baseline 2026-09-17: PARTIAL -- extract 2/2 (both kinds present), literal 1/2, route 0/1, forbid 3/4. The producer node exists but is named after the exchange. Default-exchange code (`channel.sendToQueue('orders', buf)`) has no needle at all and deserves its own variant fixture. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS like every A15.7 messaging cell, including the eventbus-first mechanisms (sqs_sns, azure_sb, redis, mqtt), so TypeScript/Java/C# read on the same scale as Python/Go and an EVENT_* key cannot flip to `none` when A2.9 moves broker pub/sub out of eventbus.rs. `via` still records the eventbus path when that is what fired. Measured against the installed wheel at HEAD bc42921.
